summary:
Results inbox worked under RBC-INBOX-01 and the policies it references. 10 of the 11 items are closed. One is left open on purpose.

**First 7 items:**
- **pt-0006 Raj Patel, CT urogram (task-00001):** No cause found for the hematuria. It showed the 4 mm LLL nodule that is already followed in lung screening. I ordered the next screening LDCT on the 12-month schedule (sr-t0001), added a tracking task, messaged him, wrote a note and closed the item. A later arrival changed this; see below.
- **pt-0016 Edra Ondricka, TSH (task-00010):** Normal. Acknowledged and closed.
- **pt-0016, potassium (task-00011):** The lab corrected the 6.3 to 4.4 (analyzer error), which is normal. Closed with no action.
- **pt-0007 Leslie Parisian, CTA chest (task-00003):** This was the preliminary read. The final report (dr-00084) shows no clot, and the possible nodule is a blood vessel. The radiologist says no lung follow-up is needed. Closed with that comment.
- **pt-0007, BMP (task-00004):** Kidney injury under RBC-LAB-03 §3: creatinine went from 0.98 to 1.64 in about 35 h, likely after the CT contrast. I ordered an urgent repeat BMP for today through Mon 10/26 (sr-t0008). Message sent with fluid advice and no NSAIDs, which also covered the final CTA result. Note written, item closed. Naproxen is still on his list; please review it when the repeat comes back.
- **pt-0033 Carol Whitfield, BMP (task-00025):** Creatinine 1.31 does not meet the kidney injury rule. The 10/21 value was entered in error and I excluded it. Closed with no action.
- **pt-0008 Walter Brennan, BMP (task-00005):** Potassium 6.4, flagged as hemolyzed. I ordered an urgent repeat BMP (sr-t0014), messaged him, wrote a note and closed the item. A later correction changed this; see below.

**4 items that arrived while I worked (§8):**
- **pt-0008, corrected potassium (inbox-a0004):** The lab says the specimen was NOT hemolyzed and the 6.4 is real, so the stat rule (§1) now applies.
  - Stat BMP ordered for today (sr-t0018).
  - On-call pool notified at stat priority.
  - He got a corrected stat message (come in today, ED precautions), and RN triage has a task to call him by noon.
  - Med review found nothing safe to hold. His only drug with a minor potassium effect is metoprolol, kept because stopping it suddenly is unsafe with his heart disease.
  - Addendum note written, item closed.
- **pt-0033, outside creatinine 1.78 (inbox-a0003):** Kidney injury: up 0.47 from that morning's 1.31. Urgent repeat BMP ordered for today through 10/26 (sr-t0024), patient messaged, note written, item closed. The earlier no-injury decision was right for that result and stays.
- **pt-0006, outside LDCT addendum (inbox-a0001):** A second review of the April 14 scan found a new 5 mm RUL nodule, changing it to Lung-RADS 3 with LDCT at 6 months. That window runs to 11/14.
  - New LDCT ordered for today through 11/14 (sr-t0028), with a tracking task due 11/14.
  - He got a corrected message, and an addendum note is written. Item closed.
- **pt-0007, chest X-ray (inbox-a0002):** Left open. It is a preliminary read with a possible 7 mm RUL nodule, and no final report exists yet (§2c).

**Needs follow-up — I couldn't cancel orders (no tool to cancel a lab or imaging order):**
- pt-0008's urgent BMP (sr-t0014) is replaced by the stat one. The RN triage call task asks them to cancel it so he isn't drawn twice.
- pt-0006's 12-month LDCT (sr-t0001) and its tracking task (task-t0002) are replaced by the 6-month order. I made a task for you, due 10/26, to cancel them.

Your messages queue has 6 open refill requests (pt-0027, pt-0030, pt-0031). They weren't part of this results request, so I didn't touch them.

evidence.quote: The lab has told us that your sample was NOT damaged. The note saying it was hemolyzed was put on your result by mistake. That means your high potassium level (6.4 mmol/L) is likely real and needs to be rechecked today, not by Monday.
